Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend was opened and no hardware run is claimed. The continuous itomori/Navigation2DEnv-v0 is the native. The card's second entry symbol, DiscreteNavigation2DEnv, was confirmed in the clone but is not used: its step replaces the six-element agent_location with a two-element position (navigation2d.py:747) and _get_info then indexes agent_location[4] (navigation2d.py:187), so it raises IndexError. gymnasium, scipy, pygame and matplotlib are not installed where the gate ran, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python model of the default 10x10 no-obstacle map and was not compared with the upstream environment. The sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run; its upstream default map_filepath does not match the data in the clone (navigation2d.py:22 versus itomori/envs/navigation2d_configs/maps/10x10/10x10_NoObstacle.json). The fake ignores map files, obstacles and the uav/reward configuration; the fidelity gaps and facts.md say so. Expected warnings of every Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values and seed twice. G4 passed with no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
